es: 💇 Arreglados los 13 peinados nuevos: de perfil y de espaldas ahora tienen su propia forma (capas, largo, coleta, trenzas, coletas o moño) igual que de frente, en todas las estructuras de chica y chico.
💇 Seis de ellos (Puntas bicolor, Coleta alta rizada, Ondas largas abiertas, Moño lateral y los dos bobs) se cortaban por arriba: ahora caben enteros.
en: 💇 Fixed the 13 new hairstyles: from the side and from behind they now have their own shape (layers, length, ponytail, braids, twintails or bun) matching the front, on every female and male body structure.
💇 Six of them (Two-tone spikes, High curly ponytail, Long open waves, Side bun and both bobs) were cut off at the top: now they fit whole.
